combo3.title: Ascended Sage into Ultimate Force: Utopia Dragonar with four materials
combo3.description: Going first with two cards: ZS - Ascended Sage and Utopic Onomatopoeia. Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light is a Utopia Xyz Monster, so it picks up the Sage's search and adds Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force. Ultimate Force turns the Rank 4 into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar with four materials: both transferred materials, Emissary of Light itself and Ultimate Force. Dragonar's Quick Effect then detaches the Sage and Onomatopoeia to Special Summon Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy, which negates a Spell on the field once per turn. Ultimate Force stays attached, so Dragonar keeps a mandatory Quick Effect: the first time your opponent activates a monster effect during the Battle Phase, it detaches everything and destroys every monster they control. Dragonar's summon effect is once per turn, not once per Duel, so it can fire again on your opponent's turn, but its 2-material cost would then take Ultimate Force with it. You can also skip the Number 38 step and hold that effect for their turn. Starting hand: ZS - Ascended Sage, Utopic Onomatopoeia. Deck needs: Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force. Extra Deck: Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light, Number 99: Utopia Dragonar, Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy.

cards.name: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy

steps.text: Special Summon ZS - Ascended Sage from your hand. You control no cards, so it can summon itself.
Normal Summon Utopic Onomatopoeia.
Xyz Summon Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light using ZS - Ascended Sage and Utopic Onomatopoeia.
ZS - Ascended Sage becomes material for Emissary of Light.
Utopic Onomatopoeia becomes the second material.
Activate effect: Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light, the search it gained from ZS - Ascended Sage.
Add Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force from your Deck to your hand. It is a Rank-Up-Magic Normal Spell, so the Sage's search can take it.
Activate Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force, targeting Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light: a Rank 4 Utopia monster whose original Attribute is LIGHT.
Special Summon Number 99: Utopia Dragonar from your Extra Deck using Emissary of Light. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.
Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light becomes material for Dragonar.
ZS - Ascended Sage transfers along with it.
Utopic Onomatopoeia transfers too.
Ultimate Force attaches itself to Dragonar as the fourth material instead of going to the GY. While it stays attached, Dragonar has the board wipe.
Activate effect: Number 99: Utopia Dragonar as a Quick Effect, detaching ZS - Ascended Sage and Utopic Onomatopoeia.
Detach ZS - Ascended Sage as the cost.
Detach Utopic Onomatopoeia as the cost.
Special Summon Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy from your Extra Deck. This is treated as an Xyz Summon.

combo4.title: Ultimate Force into Number 77: The Seven Sins (going second)
combo4.description: Going second with the same two cards. Ascended Sage still summons itself, because you control no cards. This time Ultimate Force makes Number 77: The Seven Sins, a Rank 12 Number that no earlier Utopia Rank-Up Spell could reach. It arrives with four materials. Detaching 2 banishes every Special Summoned monster your opponent controls, then attaches 1 of them to The Seven Sins. Because Ultimate Force summoned it, not its own Rank 10/11 DARK Xyz route, it can use that effect at once. Then The Seven Sins attacks with 4000 ATK. It keeps Number 39: Utopia, Ultimate Force and the stolen monster as materials, and each one can be detached instead of letting it be destroyed. Starting hand: ZS - Ascended Sage, Utopic Onomatopoeia. Deck needs: Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Ultimate Force. Extra Deck: Number 39: Utopia, Number 77: The Seven Sins.
